judged_text: The new credentialId-matching branch in createEvent — `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` with fallback to "primary" — has no test anywhere in the diff covering either the match path or the no-match path, even though the no-match path now silently targets "primary" instead of the previously selected calendar. When destinationCalendar entries don't carry the matching credentialId (exactly the 404 scenario the CalendarManager catch block at packages/core/CalendarManager.ts:230-250 was written to tolerate), Google events are created on the organizer's primary calendar without any warning, and no test in this diff asserts which calendarId is used, so a wrong-calendar regression ships undetected.
